text:
Iris: Quick non-work poll  Does the world need a "Bread Day" where we all bring our favorite loaf, share recipes, and judge by crumb? Sourdough, rye, focaccia, brioche 

Kai: Yesss. If it's a thing, I bring an overly crusty sourdough. Points for burn marks. :fire:

Marta: I'm on team 'sourdough-adjacent'  I make a mean no-knead olive focaccia. Also yes to recipe swaps.

Devon: Vote: Sourdough vs Pastry. Pastry wins for lunchtime morale. 

Priya: I will bake something gluten-free if we do. Also suggest a 'mystery loaf' round where people blind-taste and guess flour types. :thinking:

Liam: Bread Day sounds like a low-cost culture win. Can we also have a 'bread and deploy' photo contest? Snap a loaf + a green deploy. :camera_with_flash::green_heart:

Iris: Love the deploy tie-in. Poll: react :one: for Sourdough-centric, :two: for Bread Buffet (all types), :three: for Pastry takeover, :four: for GF-friendly only 

Kai: :one: :bread:

Marta: :two: :yum:

Devon: :three: :croissant:

Priya: :four: :gluten_free:

Liam: :two: :thumbsup:

RedwoodBot: Poll updated  6 reactions. Use `/culture-suggest` to add event logistics.

Iris: Thanks team  I'll collate and ping People Ops. Also open to 'bring your starter' show-and-tell.
